empty.body: Enter the Bluetooth address of your earbuds — it is listed in your system's Bluetooth settings — take them out of their case, then connect. If multipoint is on and your phone holds the control channel, turn Bluetooth off there first.
empty.title: Earbuds not connected
eq.note: Each band goes out in its own frame. Drag a point on the curve to set gain and frequency, or use the faders. The curve is computed locally (RBJ peaking filters at 48 kHz): it is a preview, not a measurement of what the earbuds actually output.
eq.qTitle: Bell width: low Q is wide, high Q is narrow
error.busy: Control channel busy. If multipoint is on, another device (a phone with the PeatsAudio app open) is holding it — turn Bluetooth off there and try again.
error.invalidAddress: Invalid Bluetooth address: expected six hex bytes separated by colons, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.noAddress: Enter the Bluetooth address of your earbuds first — it is listed in your system's Bluetooth settings.
error.noChannel: No RFCOMM channel. Earbuds off, in their case, or not paired.
error.payloadTooLong: Payload too long: a frame carries 255 bytes at most.
error.unreachable: Earbuds unreachable — off, in their case, or out of range. Paired is not enough: the system must have established the link.
error.unsupported: RFCOMM transport not implemented on this platform.
field.rawEqVendor: Send under the equaliser's vendor id (00 1D)

log.ldacEnabling: Enabling LDAC — multipoint will be turned off (they are exclusive).
log.leAudioToggling: Toggling LE Audio — the earbuds are about to reboot.
log.linkLostReconnecting: Link lost — the earbuds rebooted. Reconnecting…
log.multipointEnabling: Enabling multipoint — the firmware will turn LDAC off (not enough bandwidth over two links).
log.reconnectGaveUp: Reconnection failed after {attempts} attempts. Start it again by hand.
log.refreshed: Refreshed: {available}/{total} features available on this model.
log.touchMappingWrite: Writing the touch mapping (unverified on this hardware).
log.willReboot: The earbuds are about to reboot; reconnection is automatic.
